semantics: Model and mesh Scene previews write no objects/assets; Generate commits. Existing roll field banks each point. Path curve uses SceneGUI; editing needs explicit enable. Measurement Alt+D and path Alt+S are configurable in Settings/General. Linear, automatic smooth and independent Bezier corners use existing runtime fields.
limits: Windows D3D11 and the two recorded Unity versions only.
Shortcuts are Scene-focus-only modifier+letter bindings stored on this computer; Unity shortcut conflicts can be resolved by changing them.
Live Scene previews require explicit Generate/rebuild to commit. Point rotation banks around the path tangent; height and tangents determine slopes. Bezier corners do not impose 90 degrees.
